name: Formal Stabilization Phase Declaration
purpose: Freeze stabilization governance and define admissible future modification rules to preserve framework integrity.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The formal stabilization phase locks the compressed framework's logical profile to prevent future conceptual inflation while ensuring relation primacy remains the authoritative interpretive layer.
phase_definition.core_principle: Stability is measured by preservation of relation integrity under change, not by expansion of structure.

governance_rules.rule: Future evolution must maintain the minimal 8-operator set and 7-law family structure unless an irreducibility breach is proven.
Every modification must be screened by the Semantic Drift Sentinel for ontology inflation or relation collapse.
Counterexample visibility and incompleteness markers are non-negotiable structural requirements.
